candidates.title: Workbench chrome: the epoch line's handles
criteria: A handle on the epoch line changes the comparison: drag either bracket handle to another update of NVIDIA/stdexec#1846 and the comparison follows it; the update count the line shows is the pull request's
candidates.content: Quit any running BetterPullReview, then launch the exact bundle below. Paste the NVIDIA/stdexec#1846 link into Home and open it. Sign-in is not required. On the first open, wait for Review history is ready; fetching historical Git objects can take time. The line shows the evidenced Aug 1 and Aug 9 force-push events beside this install's live observation. Drag the right bracket from the current node to the Aug 9 node, then inspect the exact comparison in Read. The app explicitly labels incomplete history, ambiguous occurrences and the unknown original historical base; it uses a derived base for a comparison when the head is fetchable. Decide the unchanged handle criterion from what the signed bundle actually does. This read-only course does not write to GitHub.
